title: tilia mandshurica var. megaphylla
intro: Tilia mandshurica var. megaphylla, commonly known as the Manchurian linden, is a species of deciduous tree in the family Malvaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Tilia mandshurica var. megaphylla include reducing inflammation, soothing anxiety, and promoting relaxation, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
